rules.message: The form needs an add button (name="add") wired with data-hx-post — structural changes are server round trips.
Add/remove buttons must POST (data-hx-post) — a GET pager-style link cannot carry the rows.
Controls swap the whole form back (data-hx-swap="outerHTML") — the response is the only calculator, so partial swaps must be the documented narrowed variant, not the default.
The form needs method="post" and an action so the mutation buttons work without JavaScript.
The no-JS fallback must POST — the rows travel in the body.
